title: Registration Grace Days and the Hold Start Date: Calculation Sheet for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing: registration grace days.**

The registration grace days are the calendar days after a lapsed vehicle registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins. The vehicle registration on file is the latest vehicle registration upload on the standing record; once its expiry date has passed, the agreement goes on hold for an expired document with its hold start date set to that expiry date plus the registration grace days, and the hold is placed as soon as that start date has arrived.

## Figures

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Registration grace days | 1 day |
| Lowest value the grace days may take | 1 day (never fewer than one) |
| Rounding | none; a whole number of days |

## Method

1. Take the vehicle registration on file: the latest vehicle registration upload on the standing record, and the expiry date shown on it.
2. The registration grace days are 1 day, never fewer than one.
3. The hold start date is that expiry date plus the registration grace days, counted in calendar days.
4. The hold is placed as soon as the hold start date has arrived.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The latest vehicle registration upload shows an expiry date of 2026-04-30. The registration grace days are 1, so the hold start date is 2026-05-01. On 2026-04-30 the hold start date has not arrived; from 2026-05-01 it has, and the hold carries the start date 2026-05-01.

An earlier registration upload with a later expiry date does not change the reading: only the latest upload is the registration on file.
